title: Pacemaker Implantation Following Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Replacement
official: Pacemaker Implantation Following Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Replacement - Single Center Experience
summary: Transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement (TTVR) is associated with a high risk of third-degree atrioventricular block (AVB). However, the optimal pacemaker management following TTVR remains unclear. This study aims to identify an optimal therapeutic approach for pacemaker implantation in patients undergoing TTVR.
criteria:

* Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Replacement
